title: Summit Cultural Fest 2027
objectives: Create networking opportunities with industry and alumni
resources: Faculty mentors, printed material and refreshments

claims.claim_text: We expect approximately 332 attendees for this Cultural Fest, in line with turnout at our previous Cultural Fest events.
The requested budget of INR 81,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Cultural Fest.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
This event will become a flagship tradition for the university.
